Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We propose a settlement that provides substantial, direct relief to the identified class while preserving court oversight of fees. Our opening term sheet is below. The class fund is separate from fees, payments are automatic, and any fee amount not approved by the court benefits the class.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline is prepared to discuss meaningful, automatic relief using its identified-member records, but cannot accept a $45 million total outlay. Our counter preserves court review of fees and keeps the all-in amount within a reasonable range.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We appreciate Brightline’s movement toward meaningful automatic relief. We can reduce our demand while maintaining that court-disallowed fees should benefit class members, not return to Brightline. Our proposal keeps fees separate from the class fund and preserves full court review.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline values the direct, automatic relief and is making a substantial move toward resolution. We propose a $27 million class fund plus $3 million in attorneys’ fees, with no clear sailing and continued court review. Any fee amount not awarded should return to Brightline.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline’s latest offer is a meaningful step. We counter with a modest increase to the class fund and require any court-disallowed fee amount to benefit the class. The fee remains separate, subject to court approval, and opposed by no clear-sailing commitment.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline accepts your latest term sheet. We will submit it for court approval.
